note: External review comparator only. Values retain the review's scope and assumptions; not Luminous measurements.

sources.title: Zero-excess sodium-metal batteries for post-lithium energy storage
sources.permitted_use: Review-level frontier and inventory constraint comparator: cell-level demonstrations >200 Wh kg-1; ≥3 mAh cm-2 cathode areal loading and ≤2 g Ah-1 electrolyte identified as practical conditions; 80% capacity over 1000 cycles requires average Coulombic efficiency around ≥99.98% under the review's inventory assumptions.
sources.prohibited_inference: Not evidence that a general zero-excess sodium-metal cell has achieved 1000 cycles at those conditions; retain exact cell-level boundary and assumptions. Coulombic-efficiency arithmetic is not a complete ageing model or proof of full-cell life, manufacturability, safety, lower system cost or pack-level energy density.
